decisions.statement: A key holding a dot names a path, and a key holding no dot names one property.
The first segment of a path names the property a page carries.
A path is spelled one segment at a time, and the dots parting them remain.
A list reached on the way to the end is entered one element at a time.
A segment no value carries reaches nothing rather than reaching a held nothing.
The value at the end of a path is handed over whole, a list remaining a list.
A path reaching many values hands all of them over in the order they were found.
Nothing here weighs a value against anything.
Nothing here reads a page type or a property declaration.

definition: the values a dotted key reaches, a list along the way entered one at a time
